title: RecoveryWitnessView
description: Projection of imagodei HumanityWitness DHT entry when submitted under a RecoveryRequest (IntimateQuorum path). Source of truth: DHT.

recoveryRequestHash.description: ActionHash of the RecoveryRequest this witness is linked to (base64).

humanId.description: Legacy String id of the human being witnessed for — mirrors the request's resolved human_id.

note.description: Optional human-readable note from the authorizer (e.g., 'Sarah called me, recognized the dog's name').
